- **`addChunks(long blockID, boolean healthy, Collection<ChunkInfo> chunks)`** — added the `healthy` parameter; it flows down to each `ChunkMerkleTreeWriter` so `isHealthy` is set per the argument (previously hard-coded to `true`).
